### Escalations (owner action required; item decisions `escalate`)
1. **`thm-weak-maximum-principle-for-coercive-divergence-form-equations` — confirmed false hypothesis in the manifest.** The manifested weak sign condition `∫(cζ − bⁱDᵢζ) ≥ 0` has the wrong first-order sign for the library convention `L = −Dᵢ(aⁱʲD_ju) + bⁱDᵢu + cu`; since `L = −Dᵢ(aⁱʲD_ju − bⁱu) + (c − div b)u`, the condition must be `∫(cζ + bⁱDᵢζ) ≥ 0` (the weak form of `c − div b ≥ 0`). The manifested version is refuted by the radial eigenfunction on `B_π ⊂ R³` with `b = 0, c = −1`, and the proof's k-term `k∫(cu_k + b·Du_k) ≥ 0` requires the plus sign. The item is authored with the corrected condition; the manifest statement must be amended and the scope re-closed.
2/3. **`thm-weak-harnack-…-supersolutions` and `thm-harnack-…-weak-solutions` — ball quantifier narrowed.** The Moser machinery yields the standard doubled-ball form `B_{2R}(x₀) ⊂⊂ Ω` (as in [K1] Thm 2 / [K2] Thm 2), not the manifest's `B_R ⊂⊂ Ω`; the items record the provable hypothesis pending owner confirmation.
